entities.name: Lewis Hamilton
entities.description: Lewis Carl Davidson Hamilton was born on 7 January 1985 in Stevenage, Hertfordshire.

entities.name: Anthony Hamilton
entities.description: Hamilton's father, Anthony Hamilton, is of Afro-Grenadian descent.

entities.name: Carmen Larbalestier
entities.description: Hamilton's mother, Carmen Larbalestier, is White British from Birmingham.

entities.name: Nicolas Hamilton
entities.description: Hamilton's half-brother, Nicolas, is also a professional racing driver.
